Hi Camila — attached a cleaner dataflow and a proposed migration cutover schedule. See dataflow-matrix-v2.png.

Short answers to your asks:
- Managed Ingest Bridge will keep ingestion in TelemetryIO's cloud by default (multi-region). We offer EU-only tenancy as part of our Enterprise add-on (separate contract).
- Self-hosted shim keeps telemetry collection on-customer-hosted endpoints; it does not store logs but forwards compressed metrics to TelemetryIO endpoints over mTLS.

We are willing to sign a DPA addendum that restricts cross-border processing for accounts that require it; see signed-dpa-amendment.pdf (attached). If you share the list of account IDs that need onshore-only routing, we can provide per-tenant routing rules.
